verdict.rationale: Perplexity markets a 'Pro Search & Deep Research' feature with guided multi-source exploration and 'cited sources for every answer' (docs-8, docs-12, docs-27), but the documentation is thin marketing copy rather than technical detail on the autonomous research pipeline. Hands-on community reports contradict reliable delivery: a related deep-research 'Computer' feature 'often fails to trigger via the UI, and when it does work, sessions frequently stall without returning an answer' (perplexity-comm-7), citations/links are reported as 'frequently mismatched to the text' with declining accuracy (perplexity-comm-6), and a user explicitly states they now prefer Claude/ChatGPT over Perplexity 'for actual research' due to quality issues (perplexity-comm-9). Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the deep-research pipeline/methodology, independent benchmarks confirming report quality, and resolution of the reported reliability/citation-accuracy failures.
